run_greeter_server: run the gRPC Greeter server with reflection enabled on port 50051
create_greeter_servicer: create a Greeter servicer class that implements the SayHello RPC method
enable_server_reflection: enable server reflection for the Greeter service and reflection service names
start_grpc_server: start a gRPC server with a thread pool executor of 10 workers
review_greeter_sayhello: review the Greeter class SayHello method that returns a HelloReply message
